messages:
Maria Chen: FYI invoice INV-48302 shows a $12,400 burst charge on Dedicated commit 'DC-2025-Q4-01'. I think the commit should have covered some of that — can someone help reconcile?
Billing Bot: Received invoice INV-48302. Processing. If you need a credit request, reply with `approve` and `reason`.
Jamal Ortiz: Can you paste the invoice lines + the commit ID? Need to check commit utilization vs charged burst.
Maria Chen: Here are the relevant lines from the invoice:
```
INV-48302
- Reserved commit DC-2025-Q4-01: $25,000 (monthly)
- Usage (tokens): $1,200
- Burst/Overage (02/14): $12,400
- Total: $38,600
```
The commit is listed as active for Feb. Account: redwood-acme-987.
Kevin Patel: Do we have the commit entitlement terms? Usually commit covers X tokens and then overage kicks in. Might be a mismatch in how burst was attributed.
Olivia Park: @Maria could you share the commit SLO/commit id from the contract (contract ID #C-1129)? I can pull the commit bucket usage from Redwood Dedicated logs.
Maria Chen: Contract ID C-1129, commit id DC-2025-Q4-01. I pulled the usage CSV: `dc_usage_feb.csv` (attached to thread). High-level numbers below:
```
commit_bucket_tokens: 50,000,000
consumed_tokens: 52,300,000
burst_tokens_charged: 2,300,000
per_token_overage_rate: $0.0054
calculated_overage = 2,300,000 * $0.0054 = $12,420
```
Invoice shows $12,400 (rounding diff)
Jamal Ortiz: Looks like commit bucket was correctly consumed and 2.3M tokens got billed as overage. Two thoughts: 1) Did customer have a negotiated unit rate (maybe $0.0052) vs platform default $0.0054? 2) Were some tokens already invoiced elsewhere (double-bill)?
Kevin Patel: Good call. Olivia — can you confirm the negotiated rate in Zuora/contract?
Olivia Park: Pulling contract now. Contract shows overage unit price = $0.0052 for this account (signed amendment on 2025-01-15). That would yield $11,960 for 2.3M tokens. Difference vs invoice = $460.
Maria Chen: Hmm. The invoice line uses system default $0.0054. Likely billing pipeline didn't apply amendment.
Billing Bot: Policy: SLA credits and pricing amendments require manual review. Suggested action: open billing ticket and flag for manual adjustment.
Jamal Ortiz: I can open a ticket and request a billing credit for the $460 rounding/price diff. Also request re-run of billing pipeline to ensure amendment applied for future invoices.
Kevin Patel: For transparency, propose we also check whether there was any burst rate cap or monthly floor that would change final amounts. But main correction is unit price.
Olivia Park: Approving credit request for $460. Approver: Olivia Park. Reason: contract amendment price mismatch.
Maria Chen: Thanks — please include note about possible pipeline bug so eng-billing can triage (might be a mapping issue between contract amendments and invoice service).
Jamal Ortiz: Opening ticket FIN-3145 now: title "INV-48302: apply contract rate amendment C-1129 and refund $460". Assigning to billing-ops and eng-billing. Tagging @Kevin Patel for review.
Kevin Patel: Reviewing FIN-3145. If billing ops confirms, we should issue a one-time credit and add an automated test to billing CI for amendment lookups.
Billing Bot: Ticket FIN-3145 created. Status: open. Next step: billing-ops to confirm invoice adjustment and post credit memo.
Maria Chen: Can someone note whether SLA credit is also applicable? Customer mentioned a brief capacity degradation on 02/10 but that was unrelated — not requesting SLA credit now.
Olivia Park: Noted — we won't conflate SLA with pricing amendment. If they request SLA separately, we'll evaluate per SLO policy.
Jamal Ortiz: I'll follow up once FIN-3145 gets a runbook update and after the credit is posted. ETA: 48 hours.
Maria Chen: Perfect — thanks team. :pray:
Billing Bot: Invoice INV-48302 status updated to 'under review' and linked to FIN-3145.
Kevin Patel: Adding one final ask: can billing-ops drop a short note in the customer portal explaining the correction and expected time to credit? Helps CS avoid escalations.
Olivia Park: Will do after credit posted.
Billing Bot: FIN-3145 status changed to 'in progress' (assigned to billing-ops).
